acquisition_method: The mass spectrometer was operated in data-dependent (dd) positive acquisition mode, alternating between a full scan (m/z 380–1580) and subsequent HCD MS/MS of the 10 most intense peaks from the full scan
alkylation_reagent: Each sample was reduced and alkylated and processed for proteomics analysis following the solid-phase-enhanced sample-preparation (SP3) protocol as described by Hughes et al.
cleavage_agent: Enzymatic digestion was performed with Trypsin/LysC (2 µg) overnight at 37 °C at 1000 rpm.
collision_energy: The mass spectrometer was operated in data-dependent (dd) positive acquisition mode, alternating between a full scan (m/z 380–1580) and subsequent HCD MS/MS of the 10 most intense peaks from the full scan (normalized collision energy of 27%).
fragmentation_method: The mass spectrometer was operated in data-dependent (dd) positive acquisition mode, alternating between a full scan (m/z 380–1580) and subsequent HCD MS/MS of the 10 most intense peaks from the full scan
labeling: inferred: Protein label-free quantitation was performed with the Minora feature detector node at the processing step.
mass_analyzer: This equipment is composed of an Ultimate 3000 liquid chromatography system coupled to a Q-Exactive Hybrid Quadrupole-Orbitrap mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific, Inc., Waltham, MA, USA).
reduction_reagent: Each sample was reduced and alkylated and processed for proteomics analysis following the solid-phase-enhanced sample-preparation (SP3) protocol as described by Hughes et al.

instrument.evidence: This equipment is composed of an Ultimate 3000 liquid chromatography system coupled to a Q-Exactive Hybrid Quadrupole-Orbitrap mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific, Inc., Waltham, MA, USA).

ptm.value: Cysteine carbamidomethylation, Methionine oxidation, protein N-terminus acetylation
ptm.evidence: Cysteine carbamidomethylation was defined as constant modification. Methionine oxidation and protein N-terminus acetylation were defined as variable modifications.
